subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should this issue remain the canonical umbrella while focused fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with a narrower canonical design item for multi-agent completion isolation?
rationale: The source and discussion show real remaining failures, but the solution boundary spans session ownership, subagent delivery guarantees, fallback-lane behavior, and possible isolation semantics that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open, review focused PRs such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 individually, and close this only when linked session-lock, delivery, fallback, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or split.

options.title: Promote Isolation Design
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96975 the canonical product direction and explicitly map remaining bug reports to that design before closing this umbrella.

options.title: Split By Root Cause
options.body: Create or select one canonical issue per root cause and close this umbrella after each production-evidence thread is linked to its owner.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, review focused PRs such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86540 individually, and close this only when linked session-lock, delivery, fallback, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or split.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a product/architecture boundary decision, and the available history plus VISION guardrails point to steipete as the best routing owner for that choice.
